FROM FIRST BRIEF TO LIVE SITE

Bring your work.
Build alongside me.

Short demonstrations, time to build your own site, and feedback on what you’re making. Each session produces something you use in the next.
<div class="session-list">

01Set the foundationWORKSPACE + SITE PLAN+

Set up your local workspace and learn how an LLM works with your files. Decide who the site serves, how many pages you need, and the job of each page.

You leave with: a working project folder, site brief, page map, and content outline.

02Find your design directionDESIGN + BRAND BOOK+

Explore references and distinct directions in Claude Design using your own copy. Make deliberate choices about type, color, imagery, and layout, then document them in a brand book.

You leave with: your chosen design direction and a reusable visual reference.

03Build your homepageWORKING WEBSITE+

Move the design into Claude Code or Codex. Build the homepage, review it on desktop and mobile, and practice giving the AI specific feedback. Extend those patterns to your remaining pages between sessions.

You leave with: a working homepage and a repeatable way to build the rest.

04Make it yours to updateCUSTOM CONTENT STUDIO+

Build on a prepared CMS foundation. Connect the editor to your copy, images, projects, and testimonials. Practice adding a case study and checking the result before publishing.

You leave with: an editor configured for your site and a tested content update.

05Put it into the worldLIVE ON YOUR DOMAIN+

Check mobile layouts, links, contact routes, accessibility basics, and search and sharing details. Connect your domain, publish, and practice making another change and restoring an earlier version.

You leave with: a live site and a way to keep it current.

06Office hours & site reviewsQUESTIONS, SOLVED+

Bring questions from finishing and using your site. Get direct help, see what others built, and work through remaining issues. Each participant also gets a bookable 30-minute individual session with Ariba.

Bring: your site, the change you want to make, or the thing you’re stuck on.

YOUR TEACHER / ARIBA JAHAN

I built mine.
Let’s build yours.

I’m a product and experience strategist, builder, and writer. When I rebuilt aribajahan.com with AI, I documented the process: the brief, the design options, the build, and the decisions I changed along the way.

That record is the basis for this course. We’ll use my site, brand book, and CMS to work through the choices behind yours, and spend our time building.

More about Ariba ↗

BEFORE YOU JOIN

Who is this for?+

Solopreneurs and service providers who need a professional or portfolio website: a place to explain their work, show projects, and help prospective clients get in touch. The course focuses on service and portfolio sites.

Do I need to have used these tools before?+

The foundation session introduces the local workspace and working with an AI coding agent. You’ll need a computer, time to work between sessions, and the required accounts. The exact setup checklist will be confirmed before enrollment.

What can I update afterward?+

Use your CMS to edit copy, replace images, add projects or case studies, and manage testimonials. For layout changes or new features, work with your AI coding agent, check the result, and publish the change.

When does it run, and what does it cost?+

Dates, session length, and tuition are being finalized. Email Ariba for course details. Tool subscriptions, hosting, and your domain may carry separate costs; those requirements will be made clear before enrollment.

Will I own my website?+

You own the site’s code and content and control your domain and hosting accounts. The build uses tools and hosting services that have their own terms and costs. You can keep developing the site and move it to another host.
